cards.description: Campers take group instruction in Appalachian instruments, sing, and practice playing together. Instruction varies by skill level and includes Appalachian dance or arts.

cards.description: Campers audition, rehearse, and make sets and costumes for a fully staged public performance. The program moves from Sunnydale to Tryon Fine Arts Center for technical and dress rehearsals.

hours.text: Event lists a 9:00 am start; Saturday performance is at 10:30 AM.
